source.name: 4plebs (4chan Archiver)
source.short-desc: 4plebs.org is a 4chan archiver running the FoolFuuka engine. It prunes full images to save space, so the Bibliotheca Anonoma archived them here. Uploaded to the Internet Archive in November 2015.
source.capture: HOLDS NO POST TEXT — nothing here is ingestible, and the manifest exists only to record that. All nine payload files are 4plebs-<board>-2015-09-21.tar.gz (127GB total, boards adv hr o pol s4s tg trv tv x) and every one is a FoolFuuka full-image tree: <board>/<4-digit>/<2-digit>/<unixtimestampms>.<ext>, e.g. trv/1392/16/1392160614797.jpg. TWO of the nine were downloaded and scanned in full, md5s matching IA's and tar exiting 0 both times, every member verified by MAGIC NUMBER rather than extension: trv (1.09GB) is 1,713 files — 1392 jpeg, 208 png, 67 gif, 46 webm — and s4s (5.6GB) is 29,504 files — 19,693 jpeg, 7,489 png, 2,090 gif, 232 webm. Across all 31,217 files: zero unrecognised magic, zero text-like bytes, and only two extension/content mismatches (one .gif that is JPEG, one .jpg that is PNG — routine re-encoding, not corruption). s4s's 236 sub-1KB files are genuine 1x1-pixel GIFs, not truncation. The other seven were sampled at the head only (adv, pol, tv, x confirmed image trees). The title 'archiver' misleads: this is the companion image dump, not the archive. COVERAGE IS PARTIAL AND UNEVEN, which the description ('sometimes prunes full images') hints at and the scans confirm. trv holds only 1,713 files spanning 2014-02 to 2014-04 by upload time (40 / 981 / 692 per month), fetched 2014-03 to 2014-04 — nine weeks, not the board's history. s4s is wider but just as bounded: 2013-11 to 2014-04 (643 / 1003 / 1051 / 1120 / 10487 / 15200), 84% of it in the last two months, fetched almost entirely 2014-03 and 2014-04 with a single straggler in 2015-09 — so the 2015-09-21 in the filenames is the upload date, NOT the capture date. Per-board first directories differ (trv 1392 = 2014-02, s4s 1383 = 2013-11, adv 1389 = 2014-01, pol 1385 = 2013-11, tv 1365 = 2013-04, x 1364 = 2013-03), so each board starts at its own epoch and none should be assumed complete. 4plebs TEXT lives in a separate item family, 4plebs-org-data-dump-<yyyy-mm>, which ships per-board CSV rather than a mysqldump and so needs an adapter this repo does not have; 4plebs-org-data-dump-2026-01 is the current one (96GB, 11 boards, adds f/sp that this image item lacks). Its column order is documented in that item's description.
